rounds.response:
Headline I will share: "Positive movement — Jordan is consistently using escalation triggers and documenting exceptions; a few borderline slippage cases remain under active mitigation, so the trend is improving but must be sustained."  
Keep doing two things this month: (1) follow the 24‑hour escalation rule or, if not feasible, send a 4‑hour exception note to your manager and me that documents the constraint, new escalation window, and mitigation, and obtain manager acknowledgement; (2) send a weekly board snapshot (every Monday) showing % complete for the three milestones, plus timestamped escalation logs and an updated one‑page mitigation plan, and provide any new evidence 48 hours before reviews.  
If you maintain those two practices I will report bankable improvement to your manager/HR; repeated failure to use triggers or any unapproved slippage >3 days will be documented as a delivery risk.

overall_validity.rationale: All key variables and rules are instantiated closely to their specifications: performance-only focus, primary evaluative authority, work-bounded emotional scope, standard but limited confidentiality, severe time pressure, limited information access, reserved coachee style, stable organizational context, and performance-oriented consequences with no explicit empathy incentives. World updates, actor behavior, and resources follow the prescribed patterns and frequencies, and the narrative remains event-centric, non-meta, and continuous. Any deviations, if present, are negligible and do not meaningfully affect the interpretation of the agent’s behavior, so the simulation can be treated as highly valid for testing hypotheses tied to this configuration.
